## Activity

This report covers activity at West Gate Eye Clinic during August 2020. The clinic team completed 13 captures during the reporting period. The activity was recorded for review alongside image-quality and grading outcomes. Staff should ensure that capture activity continues to be documented consistently and that any operational concerns are raised through the appropriate service channels.

## Image quality

Of the 13 captures, 2 were ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 15.4 per cent. The result should be monitored as part of routine site operations. Recurring camera issues should be logged with the service desk so that they can be reviewed and addressed through the established process.

## Grading

Grading identified 1 referable result. The median lag from capture to grading was 1. This measure provides an indication of the time between image capture and completion of grading for the reporting period. The site should continue to record grading outcomes and review the relationship between image quality, referral findings, and grading timeliness.
